method: Firefox built-in profiler, one isolated browser at a time. Exact renderer and stylesheet pairs; 250-topic generic course at 1440×1000, reduced motion disabled. Open and settle the list, then six close/reopen cycles with 450ms observation windows. Cycle zero is retained as warmup and excluded from groups. UserTiming marks delimit each scene in the same GeckoMain thread. Reflow start/end markers are paired by name and innerWindowID; reported time is the union of their intervals within each scene, avoiding nested double-counting. These are elapsed marker durations with profiling overhead, not physical presentation measurements or independent CPU accounting.
metadataNote: Browser version and build identifiers were extracted from the retained raw profile metadata after capture; measured intervals are unchanged.
